evidence.quote: Tuition fee 2800 EUR/semester for EU-students (includes the Member States of the EU, EEA and Turkey) 3500 EUR/semester for non-EU students
If the transcript received from your school is not in English/Hungarian, you must have it translated into English and upload the translation together with verified copies of the original version.

notes: No application channel found in the supplied pages. Tuition is for non-EU students and is per semester.

note.fr: Épreuve de mathématiques en ligne et entretien d'admission obligatoires.
note.en: Online mathematics test and admission interview are required.

evidence.quote: All applicants have to participate in an online admission interview. Applicants are required to write an online mathematics test as part of the online admission interview.
